title: Dedicated capacity: SLA hedging & GPU-class lifecycle checklist for enterprise onboarding
text:
Dedicated capacity: SLA hedging & GPU-class lifecycle checklist for enterprise onboarding

description:
Objective: produce an operational checklist and decision flow that maps customer workload signals to SLA targets, reserved throughput commitments, GPU-class binding, and autoscale/fallback policies. Deliverables: triage questionnaire, decision matrix spreadsheet link, annotated runbook, and a short SDK contract for reservation config.

acceptance_criteria:
1) A customer-facing intake form that yields a deterministic recommendation for SLA band, reserved RPS/tokens/sec, and suggested GPU family. 2) A staging runbook with failover ladder and cost delta estimates. 3) Sign-off from Eng infra and SalesOps. 4) Sample rollout plan documented with canary and fallback steps.

comments:
2026-03-10 - Initial draft: outlined metrics to capture (peak qps, 95th/99th p99 latency, payload token distribution, model family). Action: PM to prototype scoring weights.
2026-03-11 - Eng feedback (Ravi): prefer tokens/sec over RPS for RLHF workloads; flagged KV cache sensitivity for chat-style workloads. Action: add GPU-affinity exceptions for KV-heavy workloads.
2026-03-12 - Design review (Maya Lin): suggested intake UX that surfaces cost delta early and an 'enterprise safety' checkbox. Action: include cost ballpark and compliance flags.
2026-03-13 - SalesOps (Jordan): asked for an exportable customer summary PDF and contract-friendly phrasing for burst credits. Action: add summary generator to intake flow.
2026-03-14 - Infra (Ravi): proposed two-tiered autoscale policy: predictable reserved pool for steady throughput + a pre-authorized burst lane with soft-preemption. Added note to capture GPU affinity constraints.

next_steps:
Finalize scoring matrix, stub the intake form in Prod Console, schedule cross-functional sign-off meeting 2026-03-17, and prototype sample customer PDF for SalesOps.
